# vibetesting-agent

> Free, open-source (Apache-2.0) security scanner for deployed web apps. Point it at a URL and it reports leaked API keys in JS bundles, exposed .env/.git/config, missing security headers, broken links, and SEO, accessibility and performance gaps, each with a one-line fix. Also a test library with IDOR, RBAC and tenant-isolation helpers.

## Install and run
- Zero install: `npx vibetesting-agent https://your-app.example.com`
- Global: `npm install -g vibetesting-agent`
- From source: `git clone https://github.com/newsengine/vibe-testing-agent.git && cd vibe-testing-agent && npm ci && npm run build && node dist/cli.js <url>`
